thread.title: Boeing Takes Off, AT&T Stumbles as Dow Braces for More Swings – Political Reporter

title: Boeing Takes Off, AT&T Stumbles as Dow Braces for More Swings – Political Reporter
text:
Boeing
(BA) gained ground after its results surprised on the upside. More broadly, results look normal. Over 80% of companies reporting so far from the S&P 500 have beaten bottom-line estimates and earnings have grown 20% year over year. That’s similar to last quarter. What isn’t similar is the price reaction. Is it the Guidance? The markets are forward-looking, so surely it’s guidance that has disappointed investors? Actually, Barron’s looked at 53 companies in the S&P that have updated guidance this month: 26 have increased guidance, 15 have kept it steady, and 12 have reduced it. There’s more raising then cutting. Investors just don’t care about 2018 anymore. The market needs some 2019 data points to quell rate and trade fears. GPDR: Learn that acronym. It stands for Europe’s General Data Protection Regulation. The Washington Post reported that Apple
(AAPL) CEO Tim Cook took Silicon Valley to task over privacy policies this morning. Privacy and regulation are two new risks for tech that don’t seem to be fading. Shares of Apple have ticked down 0.1% to $222.60 in pre-open trading. Morning Movers
AT&T is down 3.2% to $31.95 after reporting third-quarter earnings . The telecom giant earned 90 cents a share on revenue of $45.74 billion. Analysts were looking for earnings of 95 cents on revenue of $45.73 billion. It reaffirmed full year guidance, saying it expects to earn $3.50 a share, compared with the $3.53 consensus estimate.
Boeing is up 4.7% to $366.44 after reporting third-quarter earnings . The aerospace giant earned $3.58 a share on revenue of $25.15 billion. Analysts were looking for earnings of $3.47 on revenue of $23.84 billion. for the full year, it sees EPS of $14.90 to $15.10, compared with the $14.64 consensus estimate.
Capital One Financial (COF) is up 3.5% to $90.06 after reporting third-quarter earnings. The credit card issuer earned $3.12 a share on revenue of $6.96 billion. Analysts were looking for earnings of $2.87 on revenue of $6.88 billion. https://www.barrons.com/articles/PR-CO-20181023-914428
Etsy (ETSY) is up 2% to $43.50 after Morgan Stanley upgraded it to Equal Weight.
Texas Instruments (TXN) is down 5.9% to $94.30 after reporting third-quarter earnings . The semiconductor maker earned $1.58 a share on revenue of $4.26 billion. Analysts were looking for earnings of $1.53 on revenue of $4.3 billion. For the fourth quarter, it sees EPS of $1.14 to $1.34, compared with the $1.38 consensus estimate. —Teresa Rivas
